_comment: Static checks of one patch. Each edition applies to a range of core versions; the first edition whose bounds hold is used. targets: files relative to the hermes-agent root. contains: signs that must ALL be present after the patch (a unique marker comment plus a line of the new code is a good pair). not_contains: signs of the unpatched code that must be gone. upstream: signs that the core itself now contains the fix. Nothing here is executed.
